annotations.text: deficiency of hepatic phenylalanine hydroxylase ( PAH )
annotations.rationale: This deficiency-headed expression names reduced function of a specific molecular entity and is used in a causal disease frame ('caused by'), so the special deficiency rule applies and the whole phrase is annotated as a specific disease mention.
PKU is the standard abbreviation for phenylketonuria, referring to the same specific disease.

Although plural, this deficiency expression refers to the disease condition tied to the specific molecular entity PAH and is used in a clinical disease frame, not merely as an isolated laboratory abnormality.
